name: 09_press_disinfection_gun
title: Operating Disinfection Gun and Cabinet
summary: The robot activates a handheld disinfection gun, pans away to inspect a wall cabinet, and returns to the tabletop workspace.
robot: two robotic arms with black parallel grippers
setting: a minimalist office or lab with a large white conference table

source.original_prompt: Press the switch button of the disinfection gun

segments.instruction: Move the left gripper toward the back of the white disinfection gun held in the right gripper.
Press the power switch button on the disinfection gun with the left gripper and release.
Place the disinfection gun upright on the right side of the table and pick up the brown pad with the left gripper.
Turn the camera upward and to the left to face the upper wall cabinet, leaving the tabletop completely out of view.
segments.memory_event: hide: tabletop with the upright disinfection gun and workspace leaves camera view

segments.instruction: Reach toward the white cabinet with the left gripper and pull the door open.
Nudge a small supply bottle on the cabinet shelf with the left gripper.
Push the cabinet door closed and turn the camera back down to the conference table.
segments.memory_event: return: conference table reappears with the white disinfection gun standing on the right side

segments.instruction: Place the brown pad neatly onto the table next to the disinfection gun.
